hu.text: Ez a múzeum a 20. század eleji mozgalomnak állít emléket, amelynek keretében kínai diákok Franciaországban tanultak.

ro.name: work-study-in-France memorial site
ro.text: Acest muzeu comemorează mișcarea de la începutul secolului XX prin care studenții chinezi au lucrat și studiat în Franța.

ro.name: Ancient Lotus Garden
ro.text: O grădină chinezească clasică datând din dinastia Yuan, renumită pentru iazurile sale întinse cu lotoși.

ro.name: Bell Tower

ro.name: Baoding Zoo
ro.text: Un parc zoologic urban cu o varietate de animale, inclusiv specii rare native Chinei.

ro.name: Baoding Catholic Church
ro.text: O catedrală impunătoare din cărămidă roșie, construită în stil romanic, cu turnuri clopotniță gemene.

en.name: work-study-in-France memorial site
en.text: This museum commemorates the early 20th-century movement where Chinese students worked and studied in France.

en.name: Ancient Lotus Garden
en.text: A classical Chinese garden dating back to the Yuan Dynasty, famous for its sprawling lotus ponds.

en.name: Bell Tower
en.text: A traditional Chinese tower that served as a timekeeping center for the ancient city of Baoding.

en.name: Baoding Zoo
en.text: An urban wildlife park featuring a variety of animals, including rare species native to China.

en.name: Baoding Catholic Church
en.text: A striking red-brick cathedral built in a Romanesque style with twin bell towers.

descriptionAdvanced.en: Baoding is situated in the heart of Hebei Province, approximately 140 kilometers southwest of Beijing, and served for centuries as a strategic shield for the capital. The city has a rich history dating back to the Warring States period and was for a long time the capital of Zhili Province during the Qing Dynasty. A cultural jewel of the city is the Ancient Lotus Flower Pond, one of northern China's most famous classical gardens, established as early as the Yuan Dynasty. Baoding is also renowned for its culinary specialty, the donkey meat burger, which is cherished across the country. In the modern era, the city has emerged as a pioneer in the solar and wind energy industries, hosting major companies in the renewable energy sector. Additionally, it is the seat of several important universities and research institutes, making it an educational hub of the region. Its geographical location between Beijing, Tianjin, and Shijiazhuang makes Baoding a central component of the economic integration of the North. Despite modernization, the city preserves its historical monuments, such as the Ming-era imperial archive building, which speak of its past administrative significance.
